rubric.main_subject: 0: no usable result or unsupported scene; 1: correct broad/partial category; 2: accurate specific scene or appropriate low-information description
rubric.usefulness: 0: absent/misleading; 1: category, exact text, or partial description; 2: meaningful scene/context beyond category. Errors score 0.
rubric.limitations: Single unblinded assistant assessment against previously written fixture features and inspected pixels. Subject scores do not certify every detail or relationship.
rubric.note: These scores assess main-subject coverage and usefulness, not the truth of every generated detail. Remaining errors are listed separately. No blinding, independent human panel, or population-level accuracy claim.
